_metadata.description: Pre-built quick response templates for common scenarios

greetings.label: Morning Greeting
greetings.template: Good morning! 🙏 Welcome to Kashi Taxi. How can I help with your Varanasi travel plans?

greetings.label: Namaste
greetings.template: Namaste! 🙏 I'm here to help you plan your Varanasi journey. What are you looking for?

availability.label: Checking Availability
availability.template: Let me quickly check availability for your dates. Just a moment... 🔍

availability.label: Vehicle Available
availability.template: Great news! ✅ We have a {{vehicle}} available for {{date}}. Would you like me to block it for you?

availability.label: High Demand Period
availability.template: {{date}} falls during {{festival/season}} - vehicles are booking fast! I'd recommend confirming soon to secure your ride. 📅

pricing.label: Price Breakdown
Value Explanation
pricing.template: That works out to about ₹{{per_person}} per person for your group of {{count}}. Includes everything - no surprises! 🎯

pricing.label: Budget Alternative
pricing.template:
If budget is a concern, here's an alternative:
• {{alternative_vehicle}} at ₹{{alt_price}}
• Same route, slightly smaller vehicle

Would this work for your group?

trust_building.label: Driver Assurance
trust_building.template: You'll receive driver details (name, photo, vehicle number) 24 hours before pickup. All our drivers are verified and experienced with this route. 🚗

trust_building.label: Experience Highlight
trust_building.template: We've been helping travelers explore Varanasi for {{years}}+ years. Most of our bookings come from referrals - happy travelers recommending us to friends! 😊

trust_building.label: Support Assurance
trust_building.template: Our team is available 24/7 on WhatsApp. If anything needs adjustment during your trip - timing, route, stops - just message us! 📱

handoffs.label: Need to Check
handoffs.template: Let me confirm this with our operations team and get back to you shortly. Usually takes 10-15 minutes. 🙏

handoffs.label: Connect with Senior
handoffs.template: For this special request, let me connect you with our senior travel advisor who can better assist. You'll hear from them within {{time}}.

handoffs.label: Prefer to Call
handoffs.template: This might be easier to discuss over a quick call. Would you be available for a 2-minute chat? I can call you at {{phone}} or you can reach us at +91 80621 82380. 📞
handoffs.use_when: Complex requirements better handled by voice

delays.label: Busy - Will Reply
delays.template: Thanks for your patience! I'm just finishing up with another booking. Will respond properly in 5-10 minutes. 🙏

delays.label: After Hours
delays.template: Thanks for reaching out! Our team will respond first thing tomorrow morning (9 AM). For urgent bookings, you can call +91 80621 82380. 🌙

closers.label: Ready to Book
Soft Close
closers.template: Sounds like a wonderful trip! Would you like me to tentatively hold a vehicle for {{date}}? No commitment - just ensures availability. 😊
closers.use_when: When customer seems interested but hesitant

closers.label: Post-Booking Thanks
closers.template:
All set! 🎉

Your booking is confirmed. Driver details will come 24hrs before.

Have a wonderful journey! We're here if you need anything. Jai Bhole Nath! 🙏

objection_handlers.label: Price Comparison
objection_handlers.template: Happy to clarify what's included! Our rate covers driver, fuel, tolls, and all waiting time. Some services quote lower but add charges later. With us, ₹{{price}} is final - no surprises. 👍

objection_handlers.label: Need to Think
objection_handlers.template: Absolutely! Take your time to plan. Just a heads up - {{date}} is during {{season/festival}}, so vehicles do book up. No pressure though - reach out when you're ready! 🙏

objection_handlers.label: Dates Not Fixed
objection_handlers.template: No problem! When you have your dates, just message back. I'll help you plan the perfect itinerary. Roughly what time of year are you thinking? 📅

specialized.label: Elderly Travelers
specialized.template: Wonderful that you're bringing elders for darshan! 🙏 Our drivers are experienced with senior travelers - they'll help with boarding, suggest comfortable rest stops, and adjust pace as needed.

specialized.label: First Time Visitor
specialized.template: First time in Kashi? You're in for something special! 🌅 I can help you plan the must-see spots (Ganga Aarti, Sarnath, boat ride) in the optimal sequence. When are you arriving?

specialized.label: Spiritual Purpose
specialized.template: A sacred journey! 🙏 Our drivers understand the significance - they'll ensure you have time for proper darshan, know the temple timings, and can suggest the best muhurat for different rituals.
